evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to about 15 ppm, and it has held at 3–7 ppm through the ramp and growth
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint closely, overshot to 760 °C at the start of growth, and has settled at 750 ± 0.5 °C
Heater power has been steady at about 44–45% during growth, which fits holding 750 °C
Argon flow is steady at the 100 sccm setpoint
Controller status is 'running' and the readings keep changing, so the status is not stale

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so an exhaust blockage can only be inferred indirectly. There is no reference data to compare against, and no characterization of the sample exists yet.
